question: At what temperature were the HP/HT visualization experiments on oil reservoir conversion to underground gas storage run?
expect: not reported: the paper says only that the system can operate up to 200 °C and 100 MPa, and refers to 'formation temperature' without a value
rendered:
Phase Behavior and Mass Transfer During Oil Reservoir Conversion to Underground Gas Storage: Effects on Storage Capacity and Recovery Efficiency, page 1

The experimentally performed high-pressure/high-temperature (HP/HT) visualization experiments used a multistage protocol that mimics reservoir-to-UGS conversion, including primary depletion followed by six rolling cycles of gas injection−withdrawal (upper pressure fixed at 29 MPa; lower pressure stepwise decreased to 10 MPa). 

However, the temperature at which these experiments were run is not specified in the provided text.
